title: Gate-list encoding by gate strings
statement: For every finite list of directed acyclic Boolean gates, encoding the list by prefixing each gate’s encoding with a one and terminating with a zero gives the concatenation of those prefixed gate encodings, in list order, followed by a zero.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of directed acyclic Boolean gates
